meta.title: 第32讲 · 情态动词② 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：热身 → shall（征求意见·允诺警告·条约必须）→ should / ought to（应该·劝告·推测）→ will / would（意愿·请求·习惯·推测）→ had better / would rather（最好·宁愿）→ used to / dare（过去常常·敢）→ 情态动词的被动语态 → 综合验收（共 8 关 · 50 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 热身：情态动词第二波
nodes.explain:
第31讲认识了第一梯队：can / could、may / might、must、need。这一讲轮到第二梯队登场：shall、should / ought to、will / would、had better、would rather、used to、dare，最后再加一个杀手锏——情态动词的被动语态。

规矩没变，先把三条铁律带进场：

铁律意思对照
① 后接动词原形没有 to，没有 -ingYou should keep your promise.（√ should to keep ✗）
② 无人称变化三单也不加 -sHe should go.（√ shoulds ✗）
③ 否定、答语各有套路每家的否定形式和答语要单独记Must 问 → needn't 答（第31讲）；Ought 问 → oughtn't to 答（本讲）

本讲还有几位「编外队员」：had better、would rather、used to 严格说不是情态动词，但都后接动词原形，和情态动词一起混考；dare 则和第31讲的 need 一样是双重身份（情态动词 / 实义动词）。

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了点「我学完了」进下一关。

general_qs.stem:
--- Must I finish the report today?
--- No, you ________. You can do it tomorrow.
general_qs.explain: 上一讲的王牌答语：Must I…? 否定回答用 needn't / don't have to。A 的 mustn't 是「禁止」——老师不是禁止你交，是不必今天交。

general_qs.stem: He isn't at school today. He ________ be ill.
general_qs.explain: 没来上学 → 「一定」是病了 → 肯定推测 must。肯定句的「一定是」永远归 must 管，can 只住否定句和疑问句。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪个词是本讲的新主角（第31讲没讲过）？
general_qs.explain: 本讲第二梯队：shall、should / ought to、will / would、had better、would rather、used to、dare。can / must / need 都是第31讲的老朋友。

general_qs.stem: You'd better ________ (go) to bed now. It's late.
general_qs.explain: had better + 动词原形——本讲主角之一，先尝一口：better 后面不加 to、不加 -ing。

nodes.title: ② shall：征求意见 · 允诺警告 · 条约「必须」
nodes.explain:
shall 是「我来问、你来定」的商量词，也是法条里的「必须」，三张面孔：

用法规则例句
征求意见 / 请求主要用于第一、第三人称的疑问句，意为「要不要……？」「……好吗？」Shall I come in? / Mom, shall we go boating this weekend? / Shall the driver wait outside?
命令 / 警告 / 允诺用于第二、第三人称的陈述句，意为「可以、必须、应该」You shall have a gift if you do well in the mid-term exam.（允诺）/ She shall do as she is told.（命令）/ He shall suffer for what he did!（警告）
条约 / 法令「必须」用于第三人称陈述句，在条约、规则、法令里表示义务或规定Persons under 18 shall not be employed. 不得雇佣18岁以下的人。/ Each competitor shall wear a number.

记法：I / we 问是「商量」；你说、他说是「发话」——命令、警告、许诺；写进文件里就是「必须」。再记一条黄金搭配：Let's…, shall we?

general_qs.stem: Let's go home together, ________ ________?
general_qs.explain: Let's 开头的句子，反意疑问固定用 shall we——「我们一起回家，好吗？」这是征求意见，第一人称问句用 shall。

general_qs.stem: Shall I come in? 我能进来吗？这句里的 shall 表示什么？
general_qs.explain: 第一人称疑问句的 shall 是在问对方「要不要我进来」——征求意见 / 请求，意为「……好吗？」

general_qs.stem: shall 用于第二、第三人称的陈述句时，可以表示什么？
general_qs.explain: She shall do as she is told.（命令）/ He shall suffer for what he did!（警告）/ You shall have a gift.（允诺）——第二、三人称陈述句里 shall 是说话人在「发话」。

general_qs.stem: 在条约、规则、法令等文件里，shall 表示什么？
general_qs.explain: Persons under 18 shall not be employed. 不得雇佣18岁以下的人——法律条文里的 shall = 必须，语气像军令。

general_qs.stem: You ________ have a gift if you do well in the mid-term exam.（考得好就给你礼物，表允诺，填情态动词）
general_qs.explain: 第二人称陈述句 + 表允诺 → shall。「你期中考得好，就给你礼物」——说话人在许诺，正是 shall 的第二张面孔。

nodes.title: ③ should / ought to：应该 · 劝告 · 推测
nodes.explain:
should 和 ought to 是「应该」的双胞胎，考试专挑 ought to 的格式下手：

用法shouldought to
应该（责任义务）说话人主观认为的责任义务，可用于所有人称：You should keep your promise once you make it.可以代替 should；没有人称、数、时态的变化
委婉劝告 / 建议You should ask your parents for help. 语气不如 must / have to 强烈。Jane ought to go to bed early.
有根据的推测It should be 2 dollars. 标价错了，按理应该是 2 美元。It ought to be a fine day tomorrow morning. 按常理明天该是好天。
格式四件套否定 should not（shouldn't）否定 ought not to（缩写 oughtn't to）；疑问把 ought 提前：Ought you to…?；答语 Yes, I ought to. / No, I oughtn't to. / I don't have to.

记法：ought to 的 not 放在 to 前面（ought not to do），别写成 ought to not；问句提前的是 ought，to 永远跟着走。语气排队：must「必须」最硬，should / ought to「应该」软一档——劝告建议用它最合适。

general_qs.stem: He ________ late for class again.
general_qs.explain: ought to 的否定在 to 前加 not：ought not to be。B 死于丢了 to；C 死于 not 的位置（初中口径：not 放 to 前，不插在中间）；D 死于 ought 无人称变化，不加 -s。

general_qs.stem: You should ________ ________ ________ once you make it.（许诺了就该兑现）
general_qs.explain: should + 动词原形；keep one's promise 信守诺言。once you make it 一旦许下诺言，就该 keep it。

general_qs.stem: If you have problems, you should ________ ________ ________ ________.（向你的父母求助）
general_qs.explain: ask sb for help 向某人求助，固定搭配；should 后接动词原形 ask。遇到问题「应该」求助——should 的委婉劝告用法。

general_qs.stem: The price on the packet is wrong. It should be 2 dollars. 这句里的 should 表示什么？
options: 有根据的推测（按理应该）
general_qs.answer: C. 有根据的推测（按理应该）
general_qs.explain: 标价错了，按理说应该是 2 美元——should 表「按理说应该发生」的推测，可能性比较大，根据就是「价格错了」这个证据。

general_qs.stem:
--- Ought you to finish your homework before dinner?
--- Yes, I ________ ________.
general_qs.explain: Ought 提前的疑问句，肯定答语 Yes, I ought to——注意 to 不能丢。否定答语 No, I oughtn't to. / I don't have to.

general_qs.stem: You ought not to ________ ________ ________ too quickly.（太快下结论）
general_qs.explain: ought not to + 动词原形；jump to conclusions 过早下结论、贸然断定——固定短语，结论是「跳」过去的。

memory.front: ought to 的否定、疑问和答语？should 表推测是什么意思？
memory.back:
否定：ought not to（缩写 oughtn't to）——not 放 to 前
疑问：Ought you to…? 提前的是 ought，to 跟着走
答语：Yes, I ought to. / No, I oughtn't to. / I don't have to.
推测：It should be 2 dollars. 按理应该是——有根据的推测

nodes.title: ④ will / would：意愿 · 请求 · 习惯 · 推测
nodes.explain:
will / would 一家干四件事：

用法规则例句
意愿用于各个人称；will 表示现在的意愿，would 表示过去的意愿We will help her if she is in trouble. / She said that she would help us.
请求允许疑问句用于第二人称，询问对方意愿或提出请求；would 比 will 更客气、委婉Would you please give me a hand? 你可以帮我一个忙吗？
习惯或特性带主观性，意为「总是」；will 现在的习惯，would 过去的习惯British school children will usually eat a sandwich and a piece of fruit for lunch.
可能性 / 推测意为「可能」；would 的可能性更小Most people think students will be happy to have lighter schoolbags.

记法：will / would 四件事——愿意、请你、老习惯、说不定。疑问句里客气的 would 不是过去式，只是把语气放软；真正表过去意愿时（She said…），才轮到 would 上场顶 will 的班。

general_qs.stem: We will help her if she ________ ________ ________.（有困难）
general_qs.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时（主将从现）→ is；be in trouble 有困难、处于困境。主句 will help 是现在的意愿。

general_qs.stem: She said that she ________ ________ ________.（会帮助我们）
general_qs.explain: 主句 said 是过去时 → 过去的意愿用 would help us。will 没有过去式，过去的事一律交给 would。

general_qs.stem: Would you please ________ the window for a while?
general_qs.explain: Would you please + 动词原形——请求句式的格式锁死原形。B / C / D 分别死于 to open / opened / opening。

general_qs.stem: Would you please give me a hand? 和 Will you…? 相比，would 有什么特别？
options: would 是过去式，只能讲过去的事
would 只负责把请求问得更客气、委婉
general_qs.answer: B. would 只负责把请求问得更客气、委婉
general_qs.explain: 请求句里的 would 不是过去时，是礼貌剂——和第31讲 Could you…? 一个套路：问得客气，办的是现在的事。

general_qs.stem: British school children will usually eat a sandwich and a piece of fruit for lunch. 这句里的 will 表示什么？
general_qs.answer: C. 习惯（总是，带主观性）
general_qs.explain: will + usually 讲的是英国学生「总是」这么吃——现在的习惯特性，不是将来。will 表习惯时自带主观色彩。

general_qs.stem: will 和 would 都能表可能性，谁的可能性更小？
general_qs.explain: will 可能，would 可能性更小——和 may / might 的梯度一样，语气一软，把握就降一层。

general_qs.stem: When he was young, he ________ sit by the river for hours.
general_qs.explain: was young 锁定过去 + sit…for hours 反复发生的动作 → would 表过去的习惯「总是」。A 死于 will 没有过去式；C 死于 shall 不表习惯；D 死于「最好」语义不通。

memory.front: will / would 四大用法？Would you please…? 后接什么？
memory.back:
意愿：will 现在的意愿，would 过去的意愿（She said she would help us.）
请求：Would you please + 动词原形（比 will 更客气）
习惯：will 现在的习惯「总是」，would 过去的习惯
推测：都可能，would 可能性更小

nodes.title: ⑤ had better / would rather：最好 · 宁愿
nodes.explain:
两个「编外队员」，格式都是铁板一块：

had betterwould rather
意思「最好」——建议、警告、意见「宁愿、宁可」——说话人现在或将来的选择偏好
格式You had better do，缩写 You'd better doI would rather do sth.，缩写 I'd rather do
否定had better not do：You had better not be late for school. 最好上学别迟到would rather not do：I would rather not stay at home this Sunday. 宁愿别待在家里
比较—would rather do than do 宁愿……而不愿……：She would rather play tennis than go horseback riding.

两大考试坑：① You'd better… 的反意疑问用 hadn't you——better 不参与提问，拿出 had 来反问，别用 didn't；② would rather do than do 两边都接动词原形，than 后 even 可以省略第二个 have（have an orange than (have) a pear）。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1（下）：had better / would rather

general_qs.stem: You'd better go to hospital at once, ________?
general_qs.explain: had better 的反意疑问用 hadn't you——拿出 had 来反问。A / B 死于把 had better 当普通动词用 did；C 死于「前肯后否」——前面肯定，尾巴必须否定。

general_qs.stem: He would rather ________ at home than ________ out with friends.
general_qs.explain: would rather do than do——两处都接动词原形。B / C / D 死于往原形位置塞 to。宁愿待在家，也不愿出去逛。

general_qs.stem: You had better ________ ________ when you cross the street.（小心一点）
general_qs.explain: had better + 动词原形 → be careful。过马路「最好」小心——had better 的建议 / 警告用法。

general_qs.stem: You had better ________ ________ ________ for school.（上学不要迟到）
general_qs.explain: had better 的否定在 better 后加 not：had better not do。not 不能往后挪，也不能借 don't。

general_qs.stem: I would rather ________ ________ at home this Sunday.（这个周日宁愿不要待在家里）
general_qs.explain: would rather 的否定：would rather not do——not 放在 rather 后、动词前。和 had better not do 记成一对。

general_qs.stem: She would rather ________ ________ than go horseback riding.（打网球）
general_qs.explain: would rather do than do 宁愿……而不愿……：宁愿 play tennis，不愿 go horseback riding，than 后面原形 go 已给出。

memory.front: had better 和 would rather 的否定？反意疑问怎么说？
memory.back:
had better do = You'd better do；否定 had better not do
反意疑问：You'd better…, hadn't you?
would rather do；否定 would rather not do
比较：would rather do than do 宁愿……而不愿……（than 后接原形）

nodes.title: ⑥ used to / dare：过去常常 · 敢
nodes.explain:
used to 专讲「过去」，dare 一词两用：

规则例句
used to 过去常常过去常常做某事或过去存在某状态，侧重过去与现在的对比（现在不了 / 没了）；否定 used not to do 或 didn't use to；疑问把 used 提前，或借 did（used 还原为 use）He used to be so shy and quiet.（现在不那样了）/ There used to be a temple.（现在没了）
dare 作情态动词表示「敢、胆敢」，后接动词原形，无人称和数的变化，过去式 dared；否定 dare not / daren't；主要用于疑问句、否定句和条件从句，不用于肯定句（唯一例外 I dare say = 我看大概）I dare not swim in the pool. / How dare you ask me such a silly question?
dare 作实义动词后接不定式 to do，有人称、数、时态的变化；否定句和疑问句里 to 可省She dares to try many things. / He didn't dare (to) say what he thought. / Do you dare (to) go with me?

记法：used to 的潜台词是「现在不了」——过去常这样，如今改了；dare 看后头——接光杆原形是情态（dare not swim），接 to do 是实义（dares to try）。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1（收尾）：used to / dare

general_qs.stem: There ________ a hole in the fence that we could creep through.
general_qs.explain: There used to be 固定句型「过去曾有」——栅栏上过去有个洞（现在没了）。A 死于 be 重复；C 死于「习惯于」混入；D 死于 there be 句型里不能换成 have。

general_qs.stem: He ________ ________ ________ so shy and quiet.（过去常常很害羞很安静）
general_qs.explain: 潜台词「现在已经不那样了」→ used to be。used to 后接动词原形，专讲过去与现在的对比。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪个是 used to 的正确否定形式？
general_qs.explain: 两种否定都对：used not to do / didn't use to——借 did 时 used 还原为 use，不再加 -d。B / C 死于 did 后没还原；D 死于凭空拼凑。

general_qs.stem: I ________ ________ swim in the swimming pool and I need more practice.（不敢）
general_qs.explain: 情态动词 dare 的否定 dare not + 动词原形 swim（也可写 daren't）。后句「还需要多练」说明是「不敢」而不是「不能」。

general_qs.stem: ________ ________ you ask me such a silly question?（你怎么敢……）
general_qs.explain: How dare you + 动词原形——质问「你怎么敢」，dare 是情态动词，直接接原形 ask。这是 dare 情态用法的保留节目。

general_qs.stem: She ________ ________ ________ many things.（敢于尝试，用 dare 作实义动词）
general_qs.explain: 实义动词 dare 有人称变化：she 三单 → dares，后接 to do → dares to try。对照情态用法 dare try（无 -s、无 to）。

general_qs.stem: dare 作情态动词和作实义动词，关键区别是什么？
options: 情态 dare 后接 to do
实义 dare 后接动词原形
情态 dare 后接动词原形且无三单变化；实义 dare 后接 to do 且随人称变
general_qs.answer: C. 情态 dare 后接动词原形且无三单变化；实义 dare 后接 to do 且随人称变
general_qs.explain: 一句话分家：dare not swim（情态，光杆原形）vs doesn't dare to swim（实义，有 to 有人称）。和 need 的双重身份一个套路。

memory.front: used to 的否定和疑问？dare 的双重身份怎么分？
memory.back:
used to do 过去常常（现在不了）；否定 used not to do / didn't use to
疑问：Used he to…? / Did he use to…?
dare 情态：+ 原形，否定 dare not / daren't（How dare you…?）
dare 实义：+ to do，随人称、时态变化；否定疑问里 to 可省

nodes.title: ⑦ 情态动词的被动语态：情态动词 + be + 过去分词
nodes.explain:
被动语态套上情态动词的壳，公式一句话：情态动词（can / must / may / should / could / might）+ be + 过去分词。

句式结构例子
肯定句主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词Waste paper should be thrown into the bin.
否定句主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词Waste paper should not be thrown anywhere.
一般疑问句情态动词提前 + 主语 + be + 过去分词Should waste paper be thrown into the bin?
特殊疑问句特殊疑问词 + 情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词Where should waste paper be thrown?

更多例句：This can be done by hand. 手工做 / He may be criticized by his father. / It needn't be mentioned in your talk. / The environment should be improved.

改写三步：① 主动句的宾语提前作主语；② 情态动词后加 be；③ 动词变过去分词。not 永远紧跟在情态动词后面。

general_qs.stem:
We must plant many trees every year.（改为被动语态）
Many trees ________ ________ ________ every year.
general_qs.explain: 三步改写：宾语 many trees 提前作主语 → must 后加 be → plant 变过去分词 planted。情态动词 must 原地不动。

general_qs.stem:
We should not allow teenagers to have part-time jobs.（改为被动语态）
Teenagers ________ ________ ________ ________ to have part-time jobs.
general_qs.explain: allow sb to do → sb be allowed to do；否定时 not 紧跟情态动词：should not be allowed。teenagers 从「被允许的人」变回主语。

general_qs.stem:
Can we use the word in this way?（改为被动语态）
________ the word ________ ________ in this way?
general_qs.explain: 一般疑问的被动：情态动词 Can 提前，主语 the word，后接 be used。use 的过去分词 used——顺便记住 use-used-used。

general_qs.stem: The environment ________ ________ ________.（环境应当改善）
general_qs.explain: 环境是「被改善」的 → 情态动词被动语态：should be improved。improve 变 improved 作过去分词。

general_qs.stem: 情态动词被动语态的否定句结构是？
options: 主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词
主语 + 情态动词 + not + 过去分词
主语 + don't + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词
主语 + 情态动词 + be + not + 过去分词
general_qs.answer: A. 主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词
general_qs.explain: not 紧跟情态动词：should not be thrown anywhere。B 死于丢 be；C 死于给情态动词借 don't（情态动词从不借 do）；D 死于 not 的位置不对。

general_qs.stem: Where ________ waste paper ________ ________?（废纸应该被丢到哪里？）
general_qs.explain: 特殊疑问句：特殊疑问词 Where + 情态动词 should + 主语 waste paper + be thrown。throw 的过去分词是 thrown——别写成 throwed。

general_qs.stem:
You must finish the work before Friday.（改为被动语态）
The work ________ ________ ________ before Friday.
general_qs.explain: 宾语 the work 提前 → must 后加 be → finish 变 finished。和第30讲学的被动语态接上了：be + 过去分词外面套一件情态动词。

memory.front: 情态动词的被动语态公式？否定句、疑问句怎么变？
memory.back:
公式：情态动词 + be + 过去分词
肯定：Waste paper should be thrown into the bin.
否定：not 紧跟情态动词 → should not be thrown
一般疑问：情态动词提前 → Should waste paper be thrown…?
特殊疑问：疑问词 + 情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词 → Where should waste paper be thrown?

nodes.title: ⑧ 综合验收：七关考点一锅端
nodes.explain:
最后一关，不讲新东西——把前面七关的考点混在一起再过一遍。做错哪题，就回哪一关翻口诀卡。

验收清单：shall 问句（Shall we…?）· ought to 否定与答语 · Would you please + (not) do · hadn't you 反意疑问 · would rather…than · used to / dare not · 情态动词 + be + 过去分词。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（错哪题回哪关）

general_qs.stem: Mom, ________ we go boating this weekend?（划船好吗，填情态动词）
general_qs.explain: 第一人称疑问句征求意见 → Shall we…?（错这题回第②关）

general_qs.stem:
--- Ought he to see a doctor?
--- No, he ________.
general_qs.explain: 否定答语 oughtn't to（= ought not to），to 必须带上。B / C 死于给 ought 借 do、加 -s（ought to 是真情态动词，不借 do、不变三单）；D 死于缩写后丢了 to。（错这题回第③关）

general_qs.stem: Would you please ________ (not open) the window? It's freezing outside.
general_qs.explain: Would you please 的否定：please 后加 not + 动词原形 → not open。（错这题回第④关）

general_qs.stem: You'd better put on more clothes, ________?
general_qs.explain: had better 的反意疑问用 hadn't you。B 死于用 did；C 死于「前肯后否」；D 死于拿 would 来反问——better 句里没有 would。（错这题回第⑤关）

general_qs.stem: He would rather ________ at home than ________ out in the rain.
general_qs.explain: would rather do than do，两边都接动词原形——宁愿待在家，也不愿冒雨出门。（错这题回第⑤关）

general_qs.stem: There ________ ________ a temple on the hill, but now it's gone.（过去有一座寺庙）
general_qs.explain: There used to be 固定句型「过去曾有」；but now it's gone 正是 used to 的潜台词——现在没了。（错这题回第⑥关）

general_qs.stem: She ________ ________ swim alone, so she never goes to the pool by herself.（不敢，用 dare 的情态动词否定形式）
general_qs.explain: 情态动词 dare 的否定 dare not + 动词原形 swim（= daren't swim）。（错这题回第⑥关）

general_qs.stem: The environment ________ ________ ________.（环境应当改善，用情态动词被动语态）
general_qs.explain: 环境是「被改善」的 → should + be + 过去分词 improved。（错这题回第⑦关）
